scope: debug-client-only visual scale/readability tuning for imported character and preset sprites
notes: This lane changes debug-client presentation scale only.
The 64px source frame is now drawn at 1.25x canvas scale for readability instead of being shrunk to one tile.
Tile size is a debug-client renderer constant and does not encode map, collision, walkability, or server authority.

visual_review.method: captured debug-client screenshots with live canvas scale checks
notes: The previous active CSS max-height rules vertically compressed the square map; they were removed from active map-canvas breakpoints.
The debug-client now uses a 32px canvas tile grid and draws 64px source frames at 1.25x canvas scale for readability.

accepted_claim: The debug client renders imported character, NPC preset, and creature visual sprites at a readable, unsquashed presentation scale while preserving display-only authority boundaries.
non_claims: No production map promotion is claimed.
No server NPC, mob, collision, walkability, combat, dialogue, shop, quest, spawn, or protocol behavior is claimed.
This is a debug-client presentation change only.
